description: Template, optional: a Security Center administrator's API keys, used ONLY to read the scanner, passive-scanner, zone and organization lists in full for the instance named by for_key. Copy it to tenable-<name>-admin.secret.json under a private TAP_SECRETS_ROOT, rename the key to match the file, set for_key to the main envelope's key, and replace every REPLACE_WITH value. Never commit the filled-in copy.
